checks.limitations: The suite marks optional binary bigWig and live API/SSH/GPU acceptance separately; passing mocks do not establish those outcomes.

wheel.scope: Fresh noneditable wheel in a new environment outside the checkout; core CLI, scientific routing, packaged benchmark resources, offline curation tutorial

harness_corrections: A wheel without an installed workflow checkout also rejects pipeline --help; this is consistent with scientific launcher discovery. The initial harness incorrectly expected success.

The tutorial prints a Python summary and writes authoritative JSON to acceptance.json. The initial harness tried to parse stdout as JSON after the tutorial had already passed; it was corrected to inspect the artifact. No application behavior was changed to accommodate either correction.
